title: Product Sans / Localization
slide_intent: Plan for script coverage so the brand can remain coherent when the reader’s language changes.
strategic_value: Coordinated Latin, Greek and Cyrillic forms can give Google’s localized naming a related voice.
demonstration: Four large white words in Cyrillic, extended Latin and Greek are stacked on green, above a small note identifying Product Sans coverage and Noto Sans support.
practical_value: Check whether the needed script belongs to the displayed family or requires the broader companion coverage described by the specimen.

content_islands.name: Localized word stack
content_islands.spec: Center four large script specimens vertically in the green field.

content_islands.name: Coverage note
content_islands.spec: Place the small script-coverage explanation at lower left.

reference_purposes.Intent: The caption explains Noto Sans as a way to bridge coverage beyond the supplied scripts.
reference_purposes.Expression: The large words compare the visual character across scripts.
reference_purposes.Application: The note identifies Latin, Greek and Cyrillic coverage and the broader Noto Sans companion.

ingredient.name: Script coverage
ingredient.role: Carry a related typographic character across localized names.
ingredient.application: Use the supplied Latin, Greek and Cyrillic forms and consult the companion coverage described for other scripts.
ingredient.scope: The 2015 specimen describes Noto Sans coverage at that time; its count is historical, not a current inventory.
